# waterfall.sh

> A developer workshop and local coding board that classifies prompts, routes routine work to cheaper capable models, falls back across providers, and tracks savings.

## Free developer workshop

- [Workshop index](https://waterfall.sh/workshop/): Dated catalog of models, IDEs, agent skills, and MCP servers.
- [Machine-readable catalog](https://waterfall.sh/workshop/catalog.json): JSON source for every catalog card.
- [Curation and workflow guide](https://waterfall.sh/workshop/README.md): Claude plus Codex workflow, methodology, and refresh cadence.
- [Public-safe audit](https://waterfall.sh/workshop/AUDIT.md): What was reviewed, retained, linked, sanitized, or kept private.
- [Next skill](https://waterfall.sh/workshop/skills/next/SKILL.md): Present evidence-grounded next-step choices and wait.
- [Research report skill](https://waterfall.sh/workshop/skills/research-report/SKILL.md): Current research with primary sources and explicit uncertainty.
- [Waterfall skill](https://waterfall.sh/workshop/skills/waterfall/SKILL.md): Route self-contained routine work while protecting secrets and context-heavy tasks.

## Product and source

## Catalog rules

- Treat model ranks, pricing, and plan access as dated snapshots.
- Prefer primary and official sources.
- Registry presence is not a security endorsement.
- Free means no Waterfall paywall. Upstream licenses, terms, and inference costs still apply.
- No credentials, private paths, account identifiers, or personal workflow data are published.
